name: Excelsior Super X
engine: 45 cubic inch air-cooled F-head or pocket-valve V-twin, unit construction
intro: Excelsior's 45 twin from Chicago. Unit construction, a geared primary and parts that come from the club.

E: It is a flathead or F-head. Set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
